sourceOfTruth: portable Agent Plugin at the repository root (plugin.json, mcp.json, skills/jobsss/SKILL.md, bin/jobsss). Adapters are generated pointers to that canonical source; they contain no duplicated policy, tools, or business logic.

pi.notes: stock Pi core exposes native skill loading but no documented native stdio MCP host; proving the JobSSS runtime would require a custom extension tool bridge plus a model-authorized session, so this client is unverified and never claimed as verified.

omp.notes: this build exposes no mcp/plugin subcommand and no documented native Agent Plugins loader was established; unverified until a real isolated launch proves the JobSSS runtime.

codex.notes: isolated temporary CODEX_HOME registration is accepted for the JobSSS runtime, but a live JobSSS tool exchange could not be proven without provider authentication (probe keys are blank by design); labeled unverified until an authenticated isolated session proves the launch.

hermes.verifiedBy: real isolated launch: hermes mcp test jobsss connected to the bundled runtime in a temporary HERMES_HOME and discovered its tools
hermes.notes: verified by the compat-probe isolated launch; unverified clients and platforms are never claimed as verified.

claude.verifiedBy: real isolated launch: claude mcp list reported the jobsss stdio server as Connected under a temporary CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR
claude.notes: verified by the compat-probe isolated launch; unverified clients and platforms are never claimed as verified.

current-host.notes: current-host artifact built and exercised by the packaging slice (B30-B32): standalone bin/jobsss runs generic stdio MCP with node and jobos absent from PATH.

linux-x64.notes: byte-identical to the current-host artifact built from the real host Node executable (official v22.22.3) via the checksum-pinned postject SEA injector and exercised through generic stdio MCP under a restricted PATH (B30-B32).

linux-arm64.notes: checksum-pinned postject ELF definition over a genuine official Node v22.22.3 linux-arm64 executable validates structurally; unverified until exercised on a real arm64 Linux host.

darwin-x64.notes: checksum-pinned postject Mach-O definition (--macho-segment-name NODE_SEA) over a genuine official Node v22.22.3 darwin-x64 executable validates structurally; unverified until exercised on a real macOS x64 host.

darwin-arm64.notes: checksum-pinned postject Mach-O definition (--macho-segment-name NODE_SEA) over a genuine official Node v22.22.3 darwin-arm64 executable validates structurally; unverified until exercised on a real macOS arm64 host.

win-x64.notes: checksum-pinned postject PE definition over a genuine official Node v22.22.3 win-x64 executable validates structurally; packaging stages the signed input unsigned (Security certificate-table directory cleared to 0/0) and removes the pre-injection Authenticode certificate bytes, so the original overlay is not preserved and matching-host re-signing is a later distribution step; unverified until exercised on a real Windows x64 host.

verification.method: isolated temporary configuration only: real client binaries are launched per client with temporary HOME, XDG, and per-client home/state overrides under --config-dir; real client profiles are never read or written.
verification.trustedLocal: pending decisions are completed only on the trusted local surface ./bin/jobsss decide --data ${PLUGIN_DATA} --list; MCP handoff tools list_decision_handoffs / create_decision_handoff create non-authoritative requests only.
verification.language: local preparation and local drafts stay local; an externally observed application status is human observation recorded via the trusted local surface and attributed to the human, never to JobSSS; unsupported behavior (external sending, submission, scheduling, browser automation) is blocked or unavailable and never claimed.
verification.never: unproven clients and platforms are labeled unverified; nothing implies this plugin performed an external send, submission, or application action.
